style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent aqua-botanical gentle skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty mint aqua #CDE6DE, deep pine green #2F6B5C, olive green #7FA344 and cloud white #F4FAF7; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle water-light reflections and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with upright dropper-bottle placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
